content.title: Contact-Triggered Energy Fight | Physical Hit, Pulse Escalation, Route Resume
content.summary: Establish grounded physical conflict first, then make each brief energy pulse a visible consequence of contact before the adult resumes the route.

quick_start.input_format: The ordinary physical conflict reads before any VFX. + Energy begins at a visible contact point. + Every burst follows one completed body action. + One corridor axis preserves geography through escalation. + Particles settle before the subject resumes the original route.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place an adult transit inspector in a crowded underground passage as two smugglers block the route. The inspector pivots and sends one directional pulse through the nearest smuggler. Let the amber particles settle and the same inspector resume a calm walk through the cleared passage.
